title: EVERY KEY THAT DOES SOMETHING IS ON THE KEYS LIST
why: Found by the code comb of 2026-10-07: G (use the belt item), Q (switch throwable), Z (drop an item), V (emotes) and O (order your hire) work in the raid but were not on the CHANGE KEYS list, so putting an action on one of them did not swap: reload on G left R reloading too and the belt item gone, with no way back but RESET. They are on the list now and swap like the rest; the cursor key and the Superhot key refuse a bind.
now: CHANGE KEYS lists G, Q, Z, V and O too, and moving an action onto any key swaps the two cleanly.

edits.replacement: if(typeof logical!=='string'||typeof physical!=='string'||!physical||physical==='Escape'||physical==='Tab'||physical==='Backspace'||physical==='Backquote'||/^Digit[1-9]$/.test(physical)) return false;   // v16.xx: and never BACKSPACE (the cursor) or the key left of 1 (Superhot), which keep their own jobs
